title: Zoho Freezes Salary Hikes as Sridhar Vembu Warns of Grim Outlook for Software Jobs
hook_text: Zoho just froze all salary hikes.
script:
Zoho just froze all salary hikes for its employees this year.
Co-founder Sridhar Vembu cited surging costs driven by rapid AI adoption.
He warned of an uncertain software job market as intelligent tools reshape development.
Companies face heavy spending to keep pace with automated coding assistants.
Zoho previously rewarded staff with steady appraisals before these market shifts hit.
Tech workers now face zero salary hikes this year as software roles evolve rapidly.
Would your employer survive an industry wide software hiring freeze?
